policy: Start from stage duties, not by deleting one member of an old roster.

List duties that must be simultaneous or staged: opening contact and DP, live blocking on each route, medical coverage and target competition, artillery output and survival, roadblock/civilian passage, late mixed pressure, and #34 final settlement.
Compare at least three substantively different structures; do not count renaming or small frame adjustments as separate candidates.
Actively inspect usable capabilities of operators outside the historical success roster; do not force a new operator quota and do not force anyone out.
Explore combinations of blocking/healing fusion, output type/range, natural DP or vanguard economy, positions, and rotations; the direction is your choice.
Brief structural summaries are sufficient; do not emit three full action timelines.

For each candidate state roster, which duties are merged/replaced, what prior failure it addresses, the most dangerous concrete window, capability-support evidence, and main cost. Mark unverified claims as WAITING_RUNTIME_EVIDENCE rather than excluding by reputation or unused history.

Then autonomously select the most promising structure and emit one complete executable action timeline. If you retain a small modification of a prior roster, state which concrete facts rejected the alternatives and how the selected plan addresses them; do not use generic familiarity or stability as the reason.
Do not force Spot, Fang, Friston, or any operator either in or out; use the supplied current capability facts.
